messages:
Asha: Quick sync — FYI SOC2 fieldwork window is June 9-13. Need to confirm owners for the crypto integration checklist: KMS rotation test, HSM attestation evidence, and audit-log ingestion verification. Who's owning each?
Jordan: I can take KMS rotation tests. Planning to run a dry-run in staging Tues morning.
Priya: I can do HSM attestation evidence work, but I need the attestation template from Compliance. @Maya can you drop that here? :point_up: 
Maya: Dropping template link: https://internal.docs/reports/hsm-attest-template v1.2. Also putting required fields in the template — endorsement chain + serials.
Liam: For audit-log ingestion verification — are we validating the new kafka->ingest pipeline or the legacy s3 collector? I thought we were switching to kafka for non-prod only.
Asha: Good Q. For the fieldwork we only need evidence that logs are retained and queryable for the sample window. Either pipeline is fine; prefer kafka since that's final target. Jordan/Liam coordinate to surface queries.
Jordan: Noted. I'll wire up a smoke query: `SELECT count(*) FROM audit_logs WHERE ts BETWEEN '2025-06-01' and '2025-06-08';` will send sample outputs.
Priya: One blocker — I don't have SSH access to the HSM test node (hsm-test-03). Requesting access; opsbot said last week access was pending.
opsbot: Access request #4821 created for Priya. ETA 48h. Status: pending-approval.
Maya: Approving access now. Priya, you'll have SSH by EOD. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Thanks. I'll start collecting cert chains + attestation screenshots once I'm in.
Liam: Also found a tiny gap: rotation playbook references `key-service:v2` for staged rollouts but staging is still on v1. Need a short migration step in the playbook or else test will fail.
Asha: Action: Jordan add migration step to rotation playbook, tag @Liam to review. Priya to attach attestation files to the compliance folder. Maya to confirm doc fields. I'll collect the final checklist and send to Audit by Friday.
Jordan: Will create PR tonight — title: "rotation: add staging migration step" — pinging @Liam for review.
Liam: Will review tomorrow AM. Expect minor comments.
Maya: Compliance: expect evidence bundle format: pdf + manifest.json with filenames and sha256 checksums. I'll paste sample manifest after this thread.
Asha: One more thing — can everyone add their ownership line to the checklist doc so Audit sees single point contacts? Link: https://internal.docs/soc2/crypto-checklist
Jordan: Added my line: KMS rotation tests (Jordan).
Priya: Added HSM attestation (Priya).
Liam: Added audit-log verification (Liam).
Maya: Added compliance reviewer (Maya).
Asha: Sweet. We'll reconvene async updates here. If anything slips, escalate to me and @Maya. Thanks all. :pray:
